summaries.summary: Israeli President tasks opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government, marking a potential shift in power away from Netanyahu.
OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber after identifying multiple cybersecurity flaws, signaling advancements in AI's role in cybersecurity.
Delhi is reported as the world's most polluted major city on the eve of Diwali, with air quality reaching severe levels.
Binance's CFO is departing to pursue a new venture following a significant $6.3 billion hack, highlighting ongoing challenges in the cryptocurrency industry.
A tragic family incident in Poland shows a gunman, possibly a military cadet, who shot his family members, raising concerns regarding security.
The nostalgic return of the original Sony Walkman headphones is announced, now updated with USB-C connectivity.
NASA announces a new round of astronaut selections, inviting applications for future missions.
